title: A save whose 401 came after an upload that may have landed owes no retry, though a fresh token may mend it
evidence: Done 2026-11-26, R6 PR 5 (US-10 AC19): saveFailureCause (packages/health-core/src/save-state.ts) reads the typed reason with the typed outcome: reason 'auth' with outcome 'may-have-landed' is cause 'other', so retryOwed holds; 'auth' with 'refused' or 'no-answer' stays 'auth'; 'reconnect' is always 'auth'. No status, no words. The web Drive adapter drops a refused token (widget-src/src/storage/drive.ts refused), so the retry asks the exchange for a fresh one first; a refused grant is 'reconnect' and a fresh token Drive refuses at the first read is 'auth' and 'refused', so the retries end (widget-src/src/storage/drive-auth-retry.test.ts). The iPhone takes it with its next engine release: the network-back trigger (live-refresh.ts online) then retries such a save too. Partial 2026-11-25, R6 PR 4 (US-10 AC18, PR 2118): the web's load reader reads the typed reason. Partial 2026-11-25, R6 PR 3b (US-10 AC17, PRs 2115, 2116): every raise site names its outcome; outcome required. Partial 2026-11-25, R6 PR 3 (US-10 AC16, PR 2108): saveFailureCause reads the typed reason, no status. Found building S57b. US-09 AC30; US-11 AC3b
